title: Rereads with a stated purpose
statement: Every reread sends the student back to a chosen part of the text for a purpose they are told.
detail: A review meeting on a grade 3 course asked that rereads return to selected text for a declared knowledge purpose, and the project's router records the meeting's rule that targeted rereads serve the knowledge objective. It is a rule adopted from review, not a result measured here.
against: Telling the purpose can cost flow: a purpose line printed and spoken above every story part was later removed because it took away from the reading flow (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0230-late-sept-incidental-findings.qmd`, lines 39-41).
